description: This is a PHP source file that generates a web page for resetting or restoring a gateway device. It includes server-side PHP code, client-side JavaScript for handling user interactions and AJAX requests, and HTML structure for the user interface.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends reset or restore commands via AJAX and handles subsequent actions like rebooting or Wi-Fi restart.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Periodically checks if the system has rebooted, then redirects to login page.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends battery connection reset command via AJAX.
